Run model with no windfarm impact

bdy_model_with_impact.Rd

Computes the population model with impact from wind farms for the birds species of interest

Usage

bdy_model_with_impact(
  n_group,
  ny_data,
  posterior,
  mortality,
  ni = 1000,
  ny_proj = 30,
  progress = NULL
)

Arguments

n_group

numeric, number of groups of colonies for the bird species of interest

ny_data

numeric, number of years for which count data exist for the bird species of interest

posterior

dataframe, estimated output from bdy_model_no_impact()
columns contain estimated group size for the first year of projection (one column per group of colonies) and estimated annual growth rate (one column per group of colonies).

mortality

Matrix (rows = iterations, columns = groups of colonies) giving the distribution of mortality accross groups of colonies, as outputted by bdy_process_mortality()

ni

number of iterations

ny_proj

number of years from the last annual count for which to compute population projections

progress

R shiny Progress object used to show the calculation progress to the user. Only for use within a shiny application.

Value

List of two arrays of size (n_group)(ny_data)(ni) containing projected population size:

  • sc0: projections with no impact from wind farms (null model).

  • sc1: projections with impacts from wind farms.
